name: ai-panel-chat-is-not-the-stub
description: A question typed into the AI panel goes to the native on-device path, not the '(mock)' stub. The probe VM has Apple Intelligence off, so the native path answers with its unavailable line. A real model answer cannot be shown here and needs a check on a Mac with Apple Intelligence on.

actions.note: setup gate: the panel is on and has its chat field

actions.expression: (() => { document.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', {key: '`'})); const input = document.querySelector('.aichatinput'); input.value = 'What is this page about?'; input.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', {key: 'Enter'})); return document.querySelectorAll('.aichatlog .aibubble-me').length; })()
actions.note: opens the panel with its hotkey, then sends one question the way the Enter key does

actions.expression: (() => { const b = document.querySelectorAll('.aichatlog .aibubble-ai'); return b.length ? b[b.length - 1].textContent : 'no answer'; })()
actions.expected: On-device chat isn't available on this Mac.

actions.note: well past the stub's 450 ms timer, so a stub answer would have landed by now

assertions.desc: setup: the question landed in the chat log

assertions.expected: On-device chat isn't available on this Mac.
assertions.desc: With Foundation Models unavailable the chat shows the native error line
No '(mock)' text and exactly one answer
